about_the_game:
How far would you go to save someone you love—when you can’t even trust your own memories?

A young woman has vanished without a trace. In the storm-washed streets of a coastal town haunted by old wounds, you are Alex Hart—a detective running from your own past.

Every lead pulls you deeper into a web of suspicion. The people you meet may become your partners, your lovers, or your downfall. With each choice, trust becomes a luxury—and the line between reality and obsession blurs dangerously thin.

Features

  • Living, breathing mystery: Experience a cinematic visual novel where every relationship twists the narrative and every clue forces you to question everything—especially yourself.

  • Consequences that cut deep: No choice is without cost. Every decision shapes your investigation, your relationships, and which truths come to light—leading to multiple distinct endings.

  • Romance in the shadows: Navigate desire tangled with deception. Will love save you, or drag you deeper into darkness?

  • Psychological depth: Battle memories you can't trust, trauma that won't let go, and the creeping realization that the real danger might be you.

  • Secrets within secrets: Multiple playthroughs reveal hidden layers—missed clues, new perspectives, and the true nature of everyone involved.

  • High replayability: Uncover four entirely separate storylines with branching subpaths. Each playthrough offers new choices, revelations, and emotional consequences—no two experiences are the same.

In this town, every truth demands a sacrifice. Every bond leaves its mark.
Will you find her before you lose yourself completely?

Note: This game contains explicit adult content and themes. For mature audiences (18+) only.

🎧 Want behind-the-scenes sneak peeks and exclusive updates? Join our Discord!
